# Work queue, round 2

A local work queue helps a person find the next unfinished item and record a
choice. This round tests grouping and the arrival of work while typing. A glance
must reveal the next item in five seconds; answering happens in its row. Only
local sample data changes. One scripted arrival, initially paused, is enough.
Use `.jig/mockup.json` for foundation paths and review sizes.

| Date | Kind | Region | Reaction and action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-07 | Keep | queue-list | Keep the leading icon column and strong item name. |
| 2026-11-07 | Strong objection | work-card | Keep a visible item boundary. The previous guideline-based proposal removed it, but the person could no longer separate rows. Proximity guidance still applies; compare boundary variants, do not remove the boundary. |

Reference for grouping: https://www.nngroup.com/articles/gestalt-proximity/ . It
supports grouping related content by proximity, not this fixture's exact spacing.
Any two new row looks are unsourced candidates until compared and reviewed.
